person_note: The novel deliberately alternates sustained base sections in different grammatical persons. The third-person quote evidence follows Woolly, Emmett, and other focal characters through close-third narration, while several event passages expose a participating first-person voice. The official Penguin sample directly places an Emmett close-third section alongside sustained Duchess first-person narration, and Towles's whole-book Q&A resolves the structure: six characters' chapters are in third person, while Duchess's and Sally's are in first person. First-person dialogue and isolated gnomic statements were not promoted to base evidence, and q05512 was treated as first-person narration only because the authorized excerpt demonstrates that its dialogue bucket is erroneous. No material uncertainty remains about the book-level alternation.
